text:
alyssa_cs: Hey team, quick post-onboard catch: ran consolidated feedback from 6 pilots (AtlasPay, KineticHealth, two others). Three recurring asks and two pain signals that could affect renewals. TL;DR below. :wave:
jamal_pm: thanks — can you paste the list here? quick bullets ok.
alyssa_cs: - pain: onboarding dashboard lacks per-route token usage breakdown -> customers asking for per-team cost views.
- feature: want "scheduled prompt sets" for batch evals (run prompts nightly).
- feature: "safe-preview" mode to show outputs without sending to end-users.
- pain: missing inline examples in Console docs -> UX friction during onboarding.
- impact: AtlasPay + KineticHealth flagged renewals if not resolved; AtlasPay wants per-route toggle for billing.
sam_engineer: +1 on scheduled prompts. backend is straightforward (cron + batch queue) estimate 3-4 dev-weeks incl tests. safe-preview may be trickier (sandboxing + separate logging) -> 6-8 dev-weeks.
maria_sales: adding context — AtlasPay is 90% done with pilot; renewal convo in 10 weeks. KineticHealth delayed onboarding because Console examples unclear. Both would move to paid faster with per-route cost visibility. High commercial impact.
jamal_pm: can you quantify frequency? how many customers asked for scheduled prompt sets vs per-route billing?
alyssa_cs: scheduled prompts = 4 pilots asked; per-route billing = 3 pilots specifically asked, but 8 customers asked for more granular cost visibility overall. safe-preview = 2 pilot requests. docs/examples = 9 customers reported confusion.
feedback_bot: Auto note: CS-3421 created from thread. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-3421
jamal_pm: ok let's triage: priority matrix: (impact x effort). Per-route billing = high impact / medium effort -> P1. Scheduled prompts = medium impact / low effort -> P1 candidate. Safe-preview = high impact / high effort -> P2. Docs friction = low effort -> quick win.
sam_engineer: agree. For per-route billing we need schema changes + UI work. Estimate 4-6 weeks eng + 2 weeks frontend.
alyssa_cs: I can prep sample AtlasPay dataset and a short recording of their ask. dropping in Miro board: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVP-example
maria_sales: pls add AtlasPay renewal date to the ticket and mark as "sales-risk". I'll loop in CSM for KineticHealth.
jamal_pm: i'll create a short triage meeting — 15 min tomorrow 11am PT. @sam_engineer @maria_sales @alyssa_cs pls confirm.
sam_engineer: ✅
maria_sales: ✅
alyssa_cs: ✅. thanks — I'll attach clips and open a PR for the prompt samples after the meeting. :thumbsup:
feedback_bot: Reminder: triage meeting created in Calendar for 2026-03-22 11:00 PT.
